title: PotionCoreX
description: Make potions stackable without breaking brewing stands, hoppers or vanilla inventory behavior.
body: # PotionCoreX I made PotionCoreX because I wanted a plugin that lets potions stack properly without breaking brewing stands, hopper automation or normal inventory behavior. After testing a lot of other stackable potion plugins, this is personally the best one for me when the goal is simply to stack potions cleanly and reliably. ## Why I made it A lot of stack plugins can increase stack sizes, but they often do it in a very general way. That can cause annoying problems with brewing stands, hopper automation or potion handling in survival. I wanted something that focuses specifically on potions and water bottles and handles them in a much cleaner way. ## What PotionCoreX does - makes potions stackable - supports normal potions, splash potions, lingering potions, water bottles and base brewing potions - keeps brewing stand potion slots safe - allows hopper automation without deleting or bugging potions - keeps vanilla-like inventory behavior in survival - includes an in-game settings GUI - lets me create, save, load and delete presets - supports reloads and automatic config key updates - includes update notifications for admins - includes bStats - supports multiple languages ## Main focus The main focus of PotionCoreX is simple: **make potion stacking work properly without creating brewing bugs, hopper issues or weird inventory behavior.** ## In-game preview ### Stack size settings Here I can directly change the stack sizes for the different potion categories in the GUI. ### Save and apply This shows how I can save my settings and apply them immediately without restarting the server. ### Presets Here I can save my own preset setup and load it again later with just a few clicks. ### Languages PotionCoreX also supports multiple languages and lets me switch them directly in-game. ## For server owners I made this plugin for server owners who want potion stacking to feel practical, stable and clean instead of hacked together. If you only want a plugin for stacking potions and want that part to work properly, this is the plugin I would personally use over all the others I tested. ![bStats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/PotionCoreX.svg)
